scripts.dev:watchers: concurrently "nodemon --watch server --ext js,json --ignore dist server/app.js" "npm run sass:watch" "npm run bundles:watch" "npm run copy:watch"
scripts.copy:dist: mkdirp dist && copyfiles -u 1 "public/*.html" "public/assets/**" "public/css/**" "public/vendor/**" dist && copyfiles -u 1 "public/js/torch-worker.js" dist
scripts.copy:watch: nodemon --watch public --ext html,css,json,png,jpg,jpeg,svg,gif,ico,js --ignore dist --exec "npm run copy:dist && npm run version:inject"
scripts.copy:vendor:uikit: mkdirp public/vendor/uikit/css public/vendor/uikit/js && copyfiles -f node_modules/uikit/dist/css/uikit.min.css public/vendor/uikit/css && copyfiles -f node_modules/uikit/dist/js/uikit.min.js public/vendor/uikit/js && copyfiles -f node_modules/uikit/dist/js/uikit-icons.min.js public/vendor/uikit/js
scripts.copy:vendor:mdi: mkdirp public/vendor/mdi/css public/vendor/mdi/fonts && copyfiles -f node_modules/@mdi/font/css/materialdesignicons.min.css public/vendor/mdi/css && copyfiles -f node_modules/@mdi/font/css/materialdesignicons.min.css.map public/vendor/mdi/css && copyfiles -f "node_modules/@mdi/font/fonts/*" public/vendor/mdi/fonts
